label: Bible Study
prompt: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the _____ of God is stronger than men.
verse: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
note: God's 'foolishness' outsmarts us, and his 'weakness' outmuscles us.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Saying, The Lord is _____ indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verse: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
note: Back in Jerusalem the news was already spreading: the Lord is risen indeed, and Simon had seen Him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Pharaoh took off his _____ from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verse: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
note: From prison to palace in one day: Pharaoh's own ring, fine linen, and a gold chain for the dream interpreter.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose _____ and maker is God.
verse: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
note: Abraham lived in tents because he was looking for a city with foundations — designed and built by God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that _____ a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verse: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
note: Answering a matter before you've heard it is 'folly and shame' — the ancient rule against interrupting.
